body:
Waaahouuu 🎉 

Awesome work @bobylito it's a great page for selling features of InstantSearch.js 👍 
How ever, while testing it I've found severals bugs or small issues:

---------

There is a bug we might have not found before, when you click on the `infiniteHits -> load more` it changes also the results of the `hits` widget.

---------

The `pagination` widget styles are modified from the documentation styles:

```css
.documentation-section .documentation-container ul li, .documentation-section .documentation-container ol li, .examples-section .documentation-container ul li, .examples-section .documentation-container ol li {
    clear: both;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}
```

You should exclude the `margin-bottom: 10px` rules on any `.ais-pagination` children.

---------

The buttons hover styles are broken as well, the documentation styles override the `a:hover` with:

```css
a:hover, a:focus {
    color: #007ab3;
    text-decoration: underline;
}
```

This should be excluded from widgets on the page.

-----------

Maybe move the `clearAll` widget after the current refined values or at the end of the "Filtering widgets" section. It feels weird to clear all filters when did not played with them yet.

------------

For the `currentRefinedValues` widget, I think that `false` is not a good showcase of an already refined value.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/893837/28823741-5cf2904c-76bf-11e7-9adb-a1b935ba377d.png)
